mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 1.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during FEDFUNDS < 1.5% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low UNRATE (< 4%) signals a strong labor market, contributing to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window for UNRATE < 4% periods.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO and HOUST both exhibit YoY growth > 5%, it signals robust supply-side expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and HOUST YoY growth > 5%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of quarters meeting the dual trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during post-shock recovery (defined as RSAFS growth > 10% YoY), positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days are more likely.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window for post-shock recovery periods.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the spread between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL inflation rate (> 1%) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to favorable real interest rates.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns when FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL > 1% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a sudden increase in PAYEMS (> 200k in one month) signals labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with PAYEMS increase > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: concurrent INDPRO growth > 3% and UNRATE decrease > 0.5% in one quarter indicate supply-side efficiency gains, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth > 3% and UNRATE decrease > 0.5% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window for quarters meeting the dual trigger condition.
